reason: I'm not typing my card into some website I've never heard of to install an app that skips the App Store. I'd try the free tricks, but for real money I want it through Google Play or Apple, and as a pro I already have tools that do most of this.
objection: Paying by card on an unknown site for an app installed from the browser, with no store refunds or reviews to protect me. And free magic apps already do the photo-reveal and calculator stuff.
would_change_my_mind: Selling it through the App Store or Google Play, plus a live performance test of the search-reveal trick that holds up in front of a paying crowd.
